Explanation:  
The question asks for the director of the game that won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year twelve years before Mass Effect 2. The Ground Truth Answer provides "Martin Hollis" as the correct director. The Predicted Answer mentions "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" as the game and "Shigeru Miyamoto" as its director. While Ocarina of Time did win many awards and Shigeru Miyamoto was involved, Martin Hollis was the director of "GoldenEye 007," which won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year twelve years before Mass Effect 2. The Predicted Answer does not mention Martin Hollis at all, nor does it pick the correct game.
